source: Composition of pinned public ATen comparison and where scalar implementations
adaptation: Specialize lt/le/gt/ge scalar comparison and where_kernel_impl to FP32, compose their boolean edge without materializing TensorIterator storage, and specialize scalar broadcasting and read-only aliases. Preserve comparisons, branch operands, NaNs and signed-zero selection. These are reusable compositions of public scalar references, not imported proprietary cuDNN source. The existing adapter mechanically emits their cuDNN operation graphs. Preserve Boolean-to-float conversion and explicit scalar values.
